svg.text: General arrangement — front, side, section, top. Projected from the FreeCAD solid. Each view is fitted to its window. Dimensions in mm.

Three modules: pit 10.38 kg, hearth 8.96 kg, hood 0.00 kg · floating deck 440×520×4.0 mm · rear gutter 140 mm · soffit 110 mm (Y 110..540 mm) · mouth 424×185 mm · overall 652.8×823.0×599.0 mm · ready 30.57 kg
Dimensions in mm. Origin on the mouth plane at the deck centreline (+X right, +Y into the oven, +Z up, deck top at Z = 0).
Three modules (pit, hearth, hood): bare-steel pit with insulated belly, hearth frame with floating mild-steel deck, and insulated rectangular hood.
Rear gutter behind the floating deck admits the burner flame; overhead soffit and riser form the radiant ceiling inside the hood.
